entities.name: Savaen Expanses
entities.description: Large forest of Terisiare during the Dark Age on Dominaria, home to elves and spiders.

entities.name: Sidaine of Savaen
entities.description: Elf of the Savaen Expanses known for saying purity of magic comes from purity of the land.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Knew of the Savaen Expanses and compared them to the Tanglewoods when speaking to Jodah.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Told by Mairsil of the lands around the school.

entities.name: Tanglewoods
entities.description: Smaller yet deadly lands compared with the Savaen Expanses.

events.summary: Mairsil told Jodah of the lands around the school, comparing the Savaen Expanses' size to the Tanglewoods.
events.quote: he compared their much more impressive size to the smaller yet deadly Tanglewoods

relations.quote: the Savaen Expanses were part of the continent of Terisiare during the Dark Age
